directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.method: pdftoppm -gray at 600 dpi, whole pages, per-pixel at threshold gray < 128, counted in BOTH directions. Packet pages 1-4 map 1:1 to Superior-55 pages 1-4 per the family's own pageManifest.
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.howTheSOURCEWasRendered: WITH annotations drawn. The command is `pdftoppm -gray -r 600 -f N -l N -singlefile`, and poppler draws annotation appearances unless -hide-annotations is passed. It was NOT passed, on any render, at any point in this lane.
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.whyThatSentenceIsHereAndTheProofThatBack: A removed-pixel count taken against an annotation-free render of an AcroForm source is worthless, because an AcroForm form keeps much of what the court prints inside widget /AP /N streams: suppress them and both sides come up blank in the same places and the difference is zero by construction. VF26 measured 27,981 dark pixels of the source's own ink missing from delivered Indiana pages while the repairing lane's counter read zero for exactly this reason. So the render used here was proved to contain widget ink rather than assumed to: the SAME renderer was run over the pinned Superior-55 with and without -hide-annotations, and suppressing annotations LOSES 3,469 dark pixels on page 4 and REVEALS 2,830. Non-zero in both directions proves the render used for the diff draws /AP /N ink.
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.whichWidgetProvesIt: Group4 on page 4 -- objects 153 0 R and 134 0 R -- the very widgets this repair is about. Their /AP paints an opaque white rectangle over a box the page content stream prints and then strokes a beveled box of its own, which is why hiding annotations both loses ink (the bevels and outline) and reveals ink (the printed box beneath the mask).
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.annotationBorneInkElsewhereOnThisForm: Pages 1, 2 and 3 lose and reveal 0 dark pixels when annotations are suppressed. Superior-55's only annotation-borne ink is at the Group4 radio group on page 4, which agrees with the host's own FIX59 note that exactly one radio group per form ships its own /Off appearance while every other selection widget ships an /On state only and is drawn as nothing at /AS /Off.
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.theClaimIsTheBROADOne: These counts are an unconditional whole-page per-pixel difference. No widget mask, no rect filter and no 'accounted to a selection widget' narrowing is applied anywhere, so removed ink falling OUTSIDE every source widget rect -- the 2,632 pixels VF26 found hiding behind the narrower claim -- is inside this measurement and is counted. Removed is 0 per page, not 0 after exclusions.
